summary: Thao Pham is a 27-year-old night-shift RN on 4 West at St. Anselm Valley Medical Center, working three 12-hour nights a week and living alone in Marisol Gardens unit 207 at the start of the horizon. She is calm at a code, practical to the bone, and chronically short on sleep, and she quietly carries more of her younger sister Linh's worries than their mother Hạnh does. The September 16 charting go-live is the first thing pressing on her, along with the overtime and longer shifts it brings. Her boyfriend Tomás moves in on October 1, which means splitting rent, fridge space and quiet hours with a cheerful, messy man. The October 23 union vote has her charge nurse Maribel and organizer Terrence pulling at her from one side and her fear of rocking the boat from the other. Her voicemail inbox is a graveyard she keeps meaning to clear. What she wants is simple: enough sleep, a fair staffing ratio, and for Linh to choose a path for herself rather than copy hers.

impressions.statement: Avoids phone calls and lets anything voice-based pile up while handling texts instantly.

evidence.description: asks the assistant to draft a text to the credit union asking if she can handle a card issue by chat instead of calling
mentions 23 unheard voicemails and asks for a way to read them as text instead
asks for a voicemail greeting that says 'please text me, I work nights'
has the assistant write out exactly what to say before calling the tire shop, then asks if they take online booking

impressions.statement: Mothers Linh more than their mother does, often managing Linh's problems behind the scenes.

evidence.description: sets up a recurring $50 transfer to Linh and asks how to label it so Hạnh won't see
asks for a list of anatomy lab practical study tricks to forward Linh before Oct 17
drafts a message to Hạnh deflecting the pharmacy question on Linh's behalf
researches burr grinders for Linh's birthday, comparing grind consistency specs

impressions.statement: Stays steady and procedural in a crisis but stalls on choices that might make waves.

evidence.description: after go-live night one, asks for a clean checklist of charting downtime procedures, no complaints
asks for pros and cons of unionizing three different ways and still says she'll decide later
after a 1:7 night asks for help writing a calm incident summary for Maribel, then says she's voting yes
handles a storm flat on Ruel Road with a step-by-step tire-change list, no panic

impressions.changed_to: Still careful, but now willing to take a public position when patient safety is at stake.

impressions.statement: Expresses care through practical fixes rather than words.

evidence.description: asks for a list of heat-safe cold meals to drop at Hạnh's salon during the heat wave
asks how to make a white-noise and soothing playlist to share with the exhausted neighbors in 209
looks up how to label fridge shelves so Tomás has his own instead of saying she's annoyed
makes a freezer-meal plan for Linh's finals week
complains the kitchen is a disaster and asks for a fast cleaning order — it turns out to be Tomás's first-week mess
asks to optimize her already labeled pantry bins by expiration date
designs a fridge whiteboard chore chart with color codes
asks for a laundry routine that fits a three-night week, already tracking card balance

impressions.statement: Prefers short, direct answers and gets impatient with padding when she's post-shift.
